mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dataset (name, description, business_scene, table_name, sort, db_type, db_host, db_port, db_name, db_username, db_password, status, create_by, category_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{businessScene}, #{tableName}, #{sort}, #{dbType}, #{dbHost}, #{dbPort}, #{dbName}, #{dbUsername}, #{dbPassword}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{categoryId})
mapper.select: SELECT d.*, c.name AS category_name FROM dataset d LEFT JOIN data_category c ON d.category_id = c.id ORDER BY d.sort, d.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO table_schema (dataset_id, table_name, table_comment, relation_desc, sort, status) VALUES (#{datasetId}, #{tableName}, #{tableComment}, #{relationDesc}, #{sort}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, d.name AS dataset_name, c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name FROM table_schema s LEFT JOIN dataset d ON s.dataset_id = d.id LEFT JOIN data_category c ON d.category_id = c.id ORDER BY s.sort, s.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO table_field (table_id, field_name, field_type, field_comment, business_meaning, is_metric, semantic_type, can_query, can_agg, sort) VALUES (#{tableId}, #{fieldName}, #{fieldType}, #{fieldComment}, #{businessMeaning}, #{isMetric}, #{semanticType}, #{canQuery}, #{canAgg}, #{sort})
mapper.select: SELECT f.*, t.table_name, d.name AS dataset_name, c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name FROM table_field f LEFT JOIN table_schema t ON f.table_id = t.id LEFT JOIN dataset d ON t.dataset_id = d.id LEFT JOIN data_category c ON d.category_id = c.id ORDER BY f.sort, f.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO metric_definition (name, description, dataset_id, metric_code, metric_type, calculation_formula, sql_expression, sort, table_id, field_id, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{datasetId}, #{metricCode}, #{metricType}, #{calculationFormula}, #{sqlExpression}, #{sort}, #{tableId}, #{fieldId}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT m.*, d.name AS dataset_name, c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name FROM metric_definition m LEFT JOIN dataset d ON m.dataset_id = d.id LEFT JOIN data_category c ON d.category_id = c.id ORDER BY m.sort, m.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_category (name, color, sort) VALUES (#{name}, #{color}, #{sort})
mapper.update: UPDATE data_category SET name = #{name}, color = #{color}, sort = #{sort} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE dataset SET category_id = NULL WHERE category_id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, color, sort, create_time, update_time FROM data_category ORDER BY sort, id
SELECT id, name, color, sort, create_time, update_time FROM data_category WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, color, sort, create_time, update_time FROM data_category WHERE name = #{name}
